blocks.translation:
• This product is intended for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children under the indicated age under any circumstances.
• This product contains small parts and batteries; take care that small children do not accidentally swallow them. There is a risk of choking and other hazards.
• Do not use it close to the ear. Accidental use may impair hearing.
• Do not put fingers or similar into moving parts. There is a risk of being pinched and injured.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED light. It may cause nausea or other ill effects.
• This product uses electronic components; persons with pacemakers should exercise caution.
• Incorrect use of batteries may cause heating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• Never use secondary (rechargeable) batteries.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Set the + and − (plus and minus) polarities correctly.
• After playing, always turn off the switch and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If a battery is swallowed or battery leakage gets into the eyes, consult a physician immediately. If leaked liquid gets on skin or clothing, wash with water.
• Button batteries are dangerous if swallowed. Store them out of reach of children.
• When disposing of this product, follow your local municipal waste disposal instructions.

blocks.translation:
• Precautions for Use
• This product’s buckle is fully painted. Depending on how it is handled, the paint may be scratched or peel off, so please take care.
• The batteries installed in the Gaia Memory are for testing. Replace the batteries if the sound becomes faint or the light weakens.
• This product contains precision electronic components. Do not drop, get wet, soil, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in very high or low temperatures. Do not place this product on resin sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces; prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not pull or bend moving parts or attachment parts forcefully in unnatural directions. Some pronunciations may have different intonation or may be hard to hear due to the product’s characteristics; please understand this in advance.
• Do not insert anything other than a Gaia Memory into the main unit, as this may cause malfunction. Setting commercially sold USB memory devices, etc. may cause damage. Also, the included Gaia Memory cannot be set into computers, etc., so please take care. If a malfunction occurs, press the reset button and turn the power off and on again.
• Due to the nature of the product, appearance may vary. Please understand this in advance. Do not load the Gaia Memory included with this product into items other than compatible products such as CSM Double Driver ver.2 and CSM Eternal Edge.
• The product may malfunction due to other infrared remotes such as televisions. It may malfunction outdoors in direct sunlight. Play with it indoors.
• If a malfunction occurs, turn the power off and on again.

blocks.text: ロストドライバーの電源の入れ方 モード切替
blocks.translation: How to turn on the Lost Driver / Mode switching
How to turn on the power

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れます。
「起動音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• Turn the power switch to ON.
• A startup tone will sound.

blocks.text: ※モードごとに「起動音」が異なります。
blocks.translation: ※The startup sound differs for each mode.

blocks.text: モード切替スイッチについて

モードは3種あります。
電源スイッチをONにした状態で、モード切替スイッチを 「2/1/0」にすることで、 下記の各モードに移行します。
blocks.translation:
• There are three modes.
• With the power switch turned ON, set the mode selector switch to "2/1/0" to switch to each of the modes listed below.

blocks.text: モードごとに効果音ボタンを押した時の音声や、台詞ボタンを押した時の音声が変化します。
blocks.translation: The sounds played when you press the sound-effect button and when you press the dialogue button change depending on the mode.

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れた状態で
モード切替スイッチを 「2」に入れます。
「ジョーカー!」の音声が鳴り、
「2:左翔太郎モードの<変身前状態>」に
移行します。
blocks.translation:
• With the power switch turned ON, set the mode selector switch to "2".
• The voice "Joker!" will sound,
• and it will switch to "2: Shotaro Hidari Mode <pre-transformation state>".

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れた状態で
モード切替スイッチを 「1」に入れます。
「エターナル!」の音声が鳴り、
「1:大道克己モードの<変身前状態>」に
移行します。
blocks.translation:
• With the power switch turned ON, set the mode selector switch to "1".
• The voice "Eternal!" will sound,
• and it will transition to "1: Daido Katsumi Mode <pre-transformation state>".

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れた状態で
モード切替スイッチを 「O」に入れます。
「スカル!」の音声が鳴り、
「0: 鳴海荘吉モードの<変身前状態>」に
移行します。
blocks.translation: With the power switch turned ON, set the mode select switch to "O." The voice "Skull!" will sound, and it will switch to "0: Narumi Sōkichi Mode <pre-transformation state>."

blocks.text: ※モード切替ボタンを操作すると、ロストドライバーの音声などは中断し、状態がリセットされます。
blocks.translation: If you operate the mode change button, the Lost Driver's voice and other audio will be interrupted and its state will be reset.

各モードに応じて、下記表の「変身前台詞」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• In the <pre-transformation state>, briefly press the phrase button.
• According to each mode, the “pre-transformation lines” in the table below will play.

blocks.text:
行くぜ、フィリップ･･･。 いけね、 またクセが。
いくぜ・・・。
一体何を企んでやがる財団X。
男の目元の冷たさと優しさを隠すのが、この帽子の役目ってね。
おっと、相手はこの俺だ。
黒のライダーか。 アンタらとは何か近いものを感じるぜ。
blocks.translation:
• Let's go, Philip... Damn, that twitch again.
• Here I go...
• Just what the hell is Foundation X plotting?
• The job of this hat is to hide the coldness and the kindness around a man's eyes.
• Oh — the opponent is me.
• A Black Rider, huh? I feel something in common with you.

blocks.text:
踊るぞ。 死神のパーティタイムだ。
死人の、NEVERの力をいま味合わせてやる
違う。 俺は、仮面ライダーだ。
踊れ踊れ! 死神のパーティタイムだ。
都の諸君、朗報だ。 これから街に光が降り注ぎ、諸君らは、死ぬ。 だが安心しろ。
それは始まりでもある。 エクスビッカーの光が諸君の肉体を変質させ、俺達と同じ、
不死身の怪物へと変えてくれるだろう。さあ市民諸君、地獄を楽しみな
ハッハッハッハッハッハッハッハ。 いい気分だ!
もう実験台のバケモノは、俺だけじゃない! みんな俺と同じ、生ける死者になれ!
理由は分からんが、この曲を聞くと俺は妙に落ち着くんでね。 アンタらにも聞かせてやったのさ。
NEVERになると過去の記憶や人間らしい感情が少しずつ抜け落ちていくらしい。所詮死人
だからな。 俺にはこれがどんな曲なのかもう全く分からん。 ただ体が覚えているだけだ。
blocks.translation:
• Dance. It's the Grim Reaper's party time.
• I'll let you taste the power of the dead, the NEVER, right now.
• No. I am Kamen Rider.
• Dance, dance! It's the Grim Reaper's party time.
• Citizens of the capital, good news. Light will now rain down on the city, and you will die. But rest assured.
• It is also a beginning. The light of the Exbicker will alter your bodies and turn you into the same invulnerable monsters as us. Now, citizens, enjoy your hell.
• Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha. I feel great!
• I'm no longer the only lab-monster! Everyone become the living dead, just like me!
• I don't know why, but when I hear this song I strangely calm down. I let you hear it too.
• When you become NEVER, your past memories and human emotions apparently drop away little by little. After all, you're dead. I no longer have any idea what kind of song this is. My body just remembers it.

blocks.text:
眠れ。 相棒。
いつも言ってるよな翔太郎。 半熟のお前に帽子はまだ早い。
男の目元の冷たさと、優しさを隠すのがコイツの役目だ。
撃っていいのは撃たれる覚悟があるヤツだけだぜ。 レディ。
ガイアメモリを仕事に使わないのが俺のポリシーだったんだが、やむを得ん。
似合う男になれ。
blocks.translation:
• Sleep, partner.
• I've always told you, Shoutarou. It's still too early for a half‑baked you to wear the hat.
• This thing's role is to hide a man's coldness at the eyes and his kindness.
• The only ones allowed to shoot are those prepared to be shot. Lady.
• It was my policy not to use the Gaia Memory for work, but I have no choice.
• Become a man it suits.

いくぜ・・・。
blocks.translation:
• Looks like the trump card always comes to me.

blocks.text:
ガイアメモリを仕事に使わないのが
俺のポリシーだったんだが、やむを得ん。
blocks.translation: My policy was not to use Gaia Memories for work, but it can't be helped.

blocks.text: スカル・・おやっさん? なんだよ、俺にどうしろって・・・。
blocks.translation: Skull... Boss? What is it—what do you want me to do...?

blocks.text: おい待ってくれよ、おやっさん、おやっさん!･･･これは……。
blocks.translation: Hey, wait! Oyassan, Oyassan!... What is this...?

blocks.text: まさか･･･ここに･･･ここに来てたのか･･･。 なんて運命だ。
blocks.translation: No way... you were here... you actually came here... What a fate.

blocks.text: 最後の1つが、こいつだったなんて・・・。
blocks.translation: I can't believe the last one was this...

blocks.text: どうやら切り札は、常に俺んとこに来るようだぜ。
blocks.translation: It seems the trump card always finds its way to me.

blocks.text: じゃ行くかあ。･･････死ぬなよ。 照井。
blocks.translation: All right, let's go... Don't die on me, Terui.

blocks.text:
生きているんだろう! お前達はまだ。 過去が消えていくなら、俺はせめて明日が欲しい。
だからあがき続けてるんだよ。 なあ。 死人の俺の方が懸命に明日を求めてるってのは、
一体どういうわけなんだ。
blocks.translation:
You're still alive, aren't you? You still are. If the past is fading away, then at least I want a tomorrow.
That's why I keep struggling. Tell me—how is it that I, a dead man, am the one desperately seeking a tomorrow?

blocks.text: お前は忘れるな。 何もかも。 助けて欲しいというお前の気持ち、最初から感じてた。
blocks.translation: Don't forget—anything. I sensed your wish to be saved from the very beginning.

blocks.text: フハハハ。これだよ。 殺されそうな瞬間。 この時だけ、生きてるって錯覚ができるぜ。
blocks.translation: Hahahaha. This is it—the moment you're about to be killed. Only then can I delude myself into feeling alive.

blocks.text: 無茶言うなよ･･･ これ以上死ねるか。 俺は不死身だ。
blocks.translation: Don't be ridiculous... Could I possibly die any further? I'm immortal.

blocks.text: この世に自分の存在を刻みつけるその日まで。 永遠に。
blocks.translation: Until the day I carve my existence into this world. Forever.

blocks.text: 負けたよドクター。 よくこんな残酷な仕打ちを考えつくよ。
blocks.translation: You win, Doctor. You've come up with some cruel treatment.

blocks.text: 俺としたことが、一瞬忘れちまってたぜ。 人はみな、悪魔だという事を。
blocks.translation: For a moment there I—of all people—forgot. That all people are devils.

blocks.text: 所詮は試作品か、またいつか会おう、エターナル。
blocks.translation: So it was only a prototype after all. We'll meet again someday, Eternal.

blocks.text: みんな、俺達のゴールは決まったぞ。 風都だ。
blocks.translation: Everyone, our goal is decided. It's Fuuto.

blocks.text: 俺の依頼人に手を出すな。
blocks.translation: Don't lay a hand on my client.

blocks.text: マツ・・・お前は、超えてはならない一線を越えた。
blocks.translation: Matsu... you've crossed a line that must never be crossed.

blocks.text: どけ。 用済みはお前だ。
blocks.translation: Get out of the way. You're the one who's done for.

blocks.text: ひとつ。 俺はいつもそばにいる仲間の心の闇を知らなかった。
blocks.translation: First: I didn't know the darkness in the heart of the comrade who was always by my side.

blocks.text: ふたつ。戦う決断が一瞬った。 みっつ。 そのせいで街を泣かせた。
blocks.translation: Two: I hesitated for a moment in deciding to fight. Three: Because of that, the city was made to weep.

blocks.text: 俺は自分の罪を数えたぜ。 マツ。 さあ、お前の罪を数えろ。
blocks.translation: I've counted my own sins, Matsu. Now count yours.

source_blocks.translation: They say when you become a NEVER, memories of the past and human emotions gradually fall away. After all, we're the dead. I have no idea anymore what kind of song this is. My body just remembers it.

source_blocks.text: 所詮は試作品か、またいつか会おう、エターナル。
source_blocks.translation: So it was only a prototype after all. We'll meet again someday, Eternal.

source_blocks.translation: Everyone, our goal is decided. It's Fuuto.

source_blocks.text: 俺の依頼人に手を出すな。
source_blocks.translation: Don't lay a hand on my client.

source_blocks.text: マツ・・・お前は、超えてはならない一線を越えた。
source_blocks.translation: Matsu... you've crossed a line that must never be crossed.

source_blocks.text: いつも言ってるよな翔太郎。 半熟のお前に帽子はまだ早い。
source_blocks.translation: I'm always telling you, Shotaro: it's too soon for a half-baked guy like you to wear a hat.

source_blocks.text: どけ。 用済みはお前だ。
source_blocks.translation: Get out of the way. You're the one who's done for.

source_blocks.text: 男の目元の冷たさと、優しさを隠すのがコイツの役目だ。
source_blocks.translation: This thing's job is to hide the coldness and the kindness in a man's eyes.

source_blocks.text: ひとつ。 俺はいつもそばにいる仲間の心の闇を知らなかった。
source_blocks.translation: First: I didn't know the darkness in the heart of the comrade who was always by my side.

source_blocks.text: 撃っていいのは撃たれる覚悟があるヤツだけだぜ。 レディ。
source_blocks.translation: Only those prepared to be shot have the right to shoot. Lady.

source_blocks.text: ふたつ。戦う決断が一瞬った。 みっつ。 そのせいで街を泣かせた。
source_blocks.translation: Two: I hesitated for a moment in deciding to fight. Three: Because of that, the city was made to weep.

source_blocks.text: 俺は自分の罪を数えたぜ。 マツ。 さあ、お前の罪を数えろ。
source_blocks.translation: I've counted my own sins, Matsu. Now count yours.

• I am the hope of this new city. I am not wrong.

• It's over. Past Kamen Riders.
• My Eternal Memory is special, you see.
• Once activated, it renders Gaia Memories from before T2 inoperative, and, true to the name Eternal, it is forever.
• To the citizens of the city: I am Kamen Rider Eternal.
• I am the one who frees the pitiable residents of the boxes whose fate has been seized by the Gaia Memories.
• All 26 A to Zo memories have been gathered.
• We discarded being human; we are monsters together!
• Can you still count them now?
• Now, enjoy hell!

blocks.translation: From this moment, you're joining the ranks of the dead.

blocks.text: お前が嫁に行くときには、必ずそばにいてやる。
blocks.translation: When you get married, I'll be right there by your side.

blocks.text: ああ、約束するよ、 亜樹子。 ･･･まだ死ねん!
blocks.translation: Yeah, I promise, Akiko. ...I can't die yet!

source_blocks.text: 1 仮面ライダー、ジョーカー。
俺は仮面ライダー、ジョーカー。
へへっ。 さあ行こうか。 ファイヤーガール
source_blocks.translation: Heh. Shall we go? Fire Girl.

source_blocks.text: 次はてめえか。 ああーん?ホアーツ。 行くぜ、マッチョメン。
source_blocks.translation: You're next, huh? Ah—? Hwaa! Let's go, Macho Men.

source_blocks.text: この街を泣かせる奴は・・・許せねえ!
source_blocks.translation: I won't forgive anyone who makes this city cry!

source_blocks.text: さーてお片付けだ。一気にキメるぜ?
source_blocks.translation: Alright, time to clean up. I'll finish this off in one go!

source_blocks.text: ははっ、そこでオネンネしてな。
source_blocks.translation: Heh, just go to sleep right there.

source_blocks.text: ははっ助けに来たぜ、フィリップ。
source_blocks.translation: Haha, I came to help, Philip.
Well, I guess that's about it.

source_blocks.text: 仮面ライダー、エターナル。
俺は新しい街の希望だ。 間違ってはいない。
source_blocks.translation: I am the hope of the new city. That's not wrong.
This is... I see, so this is...

source_blocks.text: 終わりだ。 過去の仮面ライダー。
source_blocks.translation: It's over. The Kamen Riders of the past.

source_blocks.text: 久しぶりだな・・・死ぬのは･･･。 ハハハハハ･･･ハハハ、うわああーっ!(爆発音)
source_blocks.translation: It's been a long time... to die... Hahahahaha... Ha ha, waaah! (Explosion sound)

source_blocks.text: 俺のエターナルメモリは特別でね。
source_blocks.translation: My Eternal Memory is special, you know.

source_blocks.text: あの時、俺との運命を感じ、メモリはお前に使われる事を拒否したようだな。
source_blocks.translation: It seems that back then the Memory sensed its destiny with me and refused to be used by you.

source_blocks.text:
一度発動すればT2以前のガイアメモリを作動不能、エターナルの名の通り、永遠にな。
都市民諸君につぐ。俺は仮面ライダーエターナル。
source_blocks.translation:
Once activated, it will render Gaia Memories from before T2 inoperable—eternal, true to the name "Eternal."
Citizens of the city: I am Kamen Rider Eternal.

source_blocks.text: 分かるぞ。 俺が手にした時、このエターナルは全てのメモリの王者の力を発揮する。
source_blocks.translation: I can tell. When I hold it, this Eternal will demonstrate the power of the king of all Memories.

source_blocks.text: この俺こそが、真のエターナルだ。
ガイアメモリに命運を握られた、哀れなる箱の住人達を解放する者だ。
source_blocks.translation: I am the one who frees the pitiful residents of the box whose fates have been controlled by the Gaia Memories.

source_blocks.text: お前のビレッジより面白い所なんざ、もう本当の地獄くらいしかあるまい。
source_blocks.translation: There isn't much more interesting than your village—maybe only real hell.

source_blocks.text: A to Zo 26本全てのメモリが揃った。
source_blocks.translation: All 26 Memories, from A to Z, are complete.

source_blocks.text: 俺達は人間を捨てた、魔物同士だ!
source_blocks.translation: We've discarded our humanity—we're monsters among ourselves!
How could I possibly count them now?

source_blocks.text: 先に行って、遊んでこい。
たった今から、お前も死体の仲間入りだ。
source_blocks.translation: From this moment, you're joining the ranks of the dead.

source_blocks.text: お前が嫁に行くときには、必ずそばにいてやる。
source_blocks.translation: When you get married, I'll be right there by your side.

source_blocks.text: ああ、約束するよ、 亜樹子。 ･･･まだ死ねん!
source_blocks.translation: Yeah, I promise, Akiko. ...I can't die yet!
